name: ping-coming-soon-page
description: Responsive coming soon page built with HTML, Tailwind CSS and JavaScript for the Frontend Mentor Ping challenge. Validates the email on the client and server, then sends a confirmation email through a Vercel serverless function using Nodemailer.

paragraphs: A responsive coming soon page built for the Frontend Mentor "Ping coming soon page" challenge. Visitors enter their email address, and if it is valid, a confirmation email is sent to them through a serverless function.

The page follows the challenge design and adapts from small phones to large desktop screens. The email form is validated in the browser first and then validated again on the server before any message is sent.
features: Responsive layout, designed mobile-first and enhanced for larger screens
Hover and transition effects on interactive elements
Client-side email validation with clear, specific error messages
Server-side validation in a Vercel serverless function
Confirmation email delivered to the address the visitor entered
